about.title: About Us
about.desc: Operating since 2017. Trusted by more than 30 organisations for legal, compliant and rapid workforce deployment across the Kingdom.
about.heading: We supply uniformed, background-checked personnel to every sector of the Saudi economy.
about.p1: Basmat Al Mawared Company Limited is a licensed manpower supply company based in Riyadh. Since 2017 we have recruited, deployed and managed workforce for logistics, hospitality, cleaning, manufacturing and facilities clients across Saudi Arabia.
about.p2: Every placement is made on a Qiwa contract with WPS salary payment, GOSI registration and medical insurance. Transfers run through Muqeem. We handle Nitaqat alignment so your operation stays in the green tier.
about.p3: Clients keep one point of contact. We supply the people, the uniforms, the paperwork and a replacement if someone does not show. That is the whole offer.

cta.title: Need Workforce at Scale? Deploy in Days, Not Months
cta.desc: Warehouse crews, baristas, cleaners, machine operators and general helpers — uniformed, vetted and fully insured, delivered anywhere in the Kingdom with 100% MLSD compliance.

onfocus.title: Fully Compliant, Fully Transparent Workforce Management

q1.q: Are your transfers fully Qiwa and Muqeem compliant?
q1.a: Yes. Every worker we supply is registered on the Qiwa platform and processed through official Muqeem channels, with insurance, medical and contract documentation completed before deployment.

q2.q: How quickly can you deploy personnel across the Kingdom?
q2.a: Standard deployments are completed within 3-7 days depending on the role and location. For annual and enterprise agreements, we guarantee priority allocation with deployment in as little as 48 hours.

q3.q: How do you support Saudization and Nitaqat requirements?
q3.a: We recruit qualified Saudi nationals for supervisory and administrative roles, and structure your workforce mix to maintain a green-tier Nitaqat rating, keeping your organization fully aligned with Vision 2030.

coverage.title: Every Region.Ready to Deploy.
coverage.desc: From Riyadh to Jeddah, Dammam to NEOM — our uniformed teams mobilise wherever your operation runs. Recruitment pipelines across India, Bangladesh, Pakistan, the Philippines and Africa keep supply steady all year round.

cookiePolicy.shortVersion: The short version. This website sets no advertising cookies and no cross-site tracking cookies. We do not sell or share your data with advertisers. The only things stored on your device are the ones listed in the table below, and everything that is not strictly necessary stays switched off until you agree to it.
cookiePolicy.whatAreCookies: 1. What cookies and similar technologies are
cookiePolicy.whatCookiesBody: A cookie is a small text file a website stores on your device. Related technologies such as local storage work the same way in practice: they keep a small amount of information in your browser between visits. Throughout this policy we use the word “cookies” to cover both, because what matters to you is what is stored and why, not the technical mechanism.
cookiePolicy.listIntroBody: Below is the complete list. If something is not in this table, we do not store it.

cookieBamConsent.purpose: Remembers the cookie choice you made, so we do not ask again on every page. Contains only your preferences and the date you set them.

cookieBamCvDraft.purpose: Saves your CV Builder draft on your own device when you press Save Draft, so you do not lose your work. This never leaves your browser and is never sent to us unless you submit an application.

cookiePolicy.noAnalyticsNote: No analytics are installed on this website at present. There is no Google Analytics, no Meta Pixel, no advertising tag and no heatmap tool. The Analytics option in our cookie settings exists so that if we ever add one, it cannot begin collecting anything until you have given permission. This policy will be updated and your consent requested again before that happens.
cookiePolicy.strictlyNecessaryBody: These make the website work and cannot be switched off. They remember your cookie choice and help protect our forms from automated abuse. They store nothing that identifies you personally and are never used for marketing.
cookiePolicy.functionalBody: These improve the experience but are not essential. Today this covers only the CV Builder draft saved on your own device. If you decline, the website still works fully — your CV draft simply is not kept between visits. Our company video is self-hosted and needs no consent.
cookiePolicy.analyticsBody: These would tell us which pages and vacancies are viewed most, so we can improve the site. As stated above, none are currently in use.
cookiePolicy.thirdPartiesTitle: 4. Third parties that may receive data
cookiePolicy.thirdPartiesIntro: We keep third parties to an absolute minimum. Only one external service is involved in loading this website:
cookiePolicy.selfHostedVideo: Our company video is hosted on our own server
cookiePolicy.noTracking: We do not use advertising networks, social media tracking pixels, data brokers, or any service that profiles you across other websites.
cookiePolicy.choicesTitle: 5. Your choices and how to change them
cookiePolicy.choicesBody: You were asked to choose when you first arrived, and declining was made exactly as easy as accepting. You can change your decision whenever you like:
cookiePolicy.clearBrowserData: Clear your browser's site data for this domain, which erases everything listed in the table and causes the banner to appear again.
cookiePolicy.browserControls: Use your browser's own controls to block cookies generally. Every major browser offers this in its privacy settings. Blocking strictly necessary items may stop parts of the site working.
cookiePolicy.rightsBody: We process personal data in line with the Kingdom's Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL).

rightsList.0: be informed of the legal basis and purpose for collecting your personal data;
rightsList.1: request access to the personal data we hold about you;
rightsList.2: request that inaccurate or incomplete data be corrected;
rightsList.3: request that your data be destroyed when it is no longer needed for the purpose it was collected for;
rightsList.4: withdraw your consent at any time, as easily as you gave it.

cookiePolicy.rightsResponse: To exercise any of these rights, contact us using the details in section 8. We will respond within the period required by the PDPL. If you are not satisfied with our response, you may raise the matter with SDAIA.
cookiePolicy.cvBuilderTitle: 7. Job applications and the CV Builder
cookiePolicy.cvBuilderIntro: This is worth stating plainly, because it is where the most sensitive information is involved.
cookiePolicy.cvBuilderLocal: The CV Builder runs entirely in your browser.
cookiePolicy.applicationDataUsage: Application data, including identity document numbers, is used only to assess your suitability for work and to complete the employment and visa formalities required in the Kingdom. It is not used for marketing and is not sold to anyone.
cookiePolicy.contactBody: For any question about this policy, or to exercise your rights over your personal data:

contactDetails.1: RQSA4407, As Salam District, Riyadh 14226, Saudi Arabia

cookiePolicy.changesBody: If we add a new cookie or a new third-party service, we will update this page, change the date at the top, and ask for your consent again before anything new begins collecting data. Your previous choice will not be silently carried over to a purpose you did not agree to.
cookiePolicy.changeMindNote: Change your mind at any time.
cookiePolicy.noAnalyticsLabel: No analytics are installed on this website at present.

portfolioDetails.sectionSubtitle: Large-scale manpower supply delivered with full Qiwa, Muqeem and MLSD compliance across KSA
portfolioDetails.deploymentP1: Basmat Al Mawared mobilized 1,200+ background-checked blue-collar and white-collar personnel for a major Riyadh construction program. Every worker was onboarded through Qiwa, with Muqeem transfers, medicals, insurance and WPS payroll completed before site induction.
portfolioDetails.deploymentP2: Deployment was staged across 6 weeks to match the client's phase ramp-up, achieving 100% attendance from day one and zero compliance issues in Ministry of Labor and Saudi Ministry audits.
portfolioDetails.deploymentP3: For phase two, the client contracted our enterprise manpower supply agreement covering flexible staffing, payroll management and ongoing Nitaqat alignment - keeping their Saudization classification at green-tier while meeting aggressive delivery targets.
portfolioDetails.deploymentP4: Our end-to-end model - from sourcing and vetting to deployment, transfers and end-of-service benefits - gave the client a single accountable partner for the full workforce lifecycle across the Kingdom.

serviceDetails.servicesIntro: From single executive placements to multi-thousand-man labor deployments, Basmat Al Mawared delivers background-checked personnel, 100% MLSD compliant documentation, and rapid mobilization across the Kingdom.
serviceDetails.serviceLead: Basmat Al Mawared Company Limited manages the complete workforce lifecycle - recruitment, visa processing, Qiwa registration, Muqeem transfers, medical and insurance, WPS payroll, and end-of-service benefits - so your operations run uninterrupted.
serviceDetails.li1: Background-checked personnel ready for rapid deployment across KSA.
serviceDetails.li2: Full Qiwa, Muqeem and GOSI processing handled by our compliance desk.
serviceDetails.li3: 100% MLSD compliant, with transparent pricing and SLAs.
serviceDetails.serviceBody1: Our recruitment team sources, vets and onboards candidates across construction, manufacturing, hospitality, oil & gas and white-collar sectors, aligned with Saudization and Nitaqat green-tier requirements.
serviceDetails.serviceBody2: Whether you need monthly flexible staffing, dedicated contract teams or an enterprise manpower supply agreement, we scale to your demand and guarantee compliant, reliable labor - with dedicated account management from Riyadh headquarters.

cookieConsent.cookieBannerDesc: This site uses only what it needs to work. We do not track you across other websites, and we set no advertising cookies. You can accept, decline, or choose exactly what to allow. Read our Cookie Policy.
cookieConsent.cookieDialogDesc: Choose what you allow. Your choice is saved on this device and you can change it at any time.
cookieConsent.cookieEssentialDesc: Required for the site to function: remembering this cookie choice, keeping a form submission secure, and limiting automated spam. These store nothing that identifies you and cannot be switched off.
cookieConsent.cookieFunctionalDesc: Enables the embedded YouTube video and saves a CV Builder draft on your own device so you do not lose your work. Your CV draft never leaves your browser unless you submit an application. Declining keeps the video blocked.
cookieConsent.cookieAnalyticsDesc: Anonymous statistics about which pages and vacancies are viewed, so we can improve the site. No analytics tool is currently installed, so this setting has no effect today. It is here so that nothing can start collecting data without your permission.
